title: india_lp Policy Principle Record
description: A modular, OpenEvo-authored policy principle -- the compilable unit that policy briefs and other outreach materials are built from. Distinct from local_policy records: those describe external institutional facts (verificationStatus); this describes OUR authored position, grounded in those facts via groundedIn, using the ordinary ecosystem review_status lifecycle instead of a verification status. Identical shape to deutsche_lp's/nys_lp's policy-principle-record.schema.json. No records exist under this schema yet as of this repo's founding session (2026-09-30) -- founding-session work was institutional/licensing groundwork, not yet an authored outreach position.

jurisdictionScope.description: 'IN' for a national-level principle (lives in national_ccs_policy/), a specific state code for a state-adapted version (lives in state/<state>/ccs_policy/).

groundedIn.description: Ids of local_policy records (institutional actors, timeline events, curriculum crosswalks, mandates, coherence findings) this principle is grounded in or responds to.
